intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S2 of Initiative explicit-phase-entry per docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (T1, T2): a host-neutral phase-entry module plus the Claude Code gate, so enroll and start_unattended_batch are refused before any native dialog in a session without a live literal-user imm-run entry, and a model Skill call for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm or imm-run is denied without a matching entry. Characterize the real UserPromptSubmit payload of a slash entry first (assumption A1). User scenarios SCN-3 and SCN-4 belong to this Slice.

acceptance.assertion: Per T1 and invariants I2, I3 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: delegated technical choices D3, D7): runtime/assurance/phase_entry.ts recognizes a literal entry for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm and imm-run by packaged name, by immune-brain: or skill: prefix, by a user alias whose command file names exactly one of those skills (imm-loop maps to run), and in the Host-expanded command form; a mid-sentence mention, an unknown command and non-user text are not entries. A run entry stays live across later prompts; a later plan entry revokes it; a missing or unreadable store refuses. Seam: new tests/phase-entry.test.ts on the pure module with positive, negative and bound controls for each rule.

Per T2 and invariants I1, I3, I5 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U2; repository evidence runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts): on Claude Code, enroll and start_unattended_batch reach the native gate port only when the session has a live run entry and the PreToolUse hook wrote an admission for the call's claudecode/toolUseId; with no entry, a revoked entry, or no admission the call returns reason code run_entry_required with exactly one same-Host recovery action and the gate port is never called; batch-internal reuseOnly continuation is not gated. Seam: new tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts driving the hook output functions and handleJsonRpc.

Per T1, T2 and decision D4 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U2 refined by D4): the Claude PreToolUse hook denies a Skill call for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm or imm-run with reason code phase_entry_required unless the matching entry was recorded in the latest literal prompt, or, for imm-planner, a run entry is live and a Managed claim is active; every other Skill and tool is left untouched. Seam: new tests/claude-phase-entry-skill-gate.test.ts on the hook output for Skill PreToolUse payloads, with allowed, denied and untouched controls.

Per Discovery evidence of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: repository evidence scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts, hooks/hooks.json): hooks.json registers PreToolUse for the Skill tool and for the plugin enroll and start_unattended_batch tools, dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is rebuilt from source, and the existing Claude tool-boundary tests pass with a recorded run entry and admission where they exercise enroll or start_unattended_batch.

attestations.summary: Provenance verified (base, review commit, single parent and tree match the manifest; manifest_digest matches the request but was not independently recomputed); all 18 per-file diffs read; the pure entry module, hook gate, single-use admission bound to tool-use id, and gate placement before preparation and native dialog satisfy EPE-S2-A1..A4 with positive, negative and bound tests at the named seams.

advisory_findings.summary: Hook-side store failures are not uniformly fail-closed for the Skill gate: runHook ignores the result of recordPhaseEntryPrompt, so a failed append of a plan entry leaves an earlier run entry live and still 'latest', and readPrivate can throw out of readPhaseEntryState with no catch in runHook, in which case the hook exits non-zero without a deny and a Skill call proceeds. The enroll and start_unattended_batch path stays closed because it still needs an admission.

evidence.trigger: UserPromptSubmit for '/imm-planner' after a recorded '/imm-run' where appendPrivate returns false (for example a short or failed write), followed by Skill(imm-run); or a PreToolUse Skill payload where fstatSync/readSync throws inside readPrivate

advisory_findings.summary: The admission is appended, not written exclusively, and consumePhaseAdmission requires exactly one line, so any second PreToolUse hook run for the same tool_use_id (for example two enabled copies of the plugin, whose hooks.json matcher both match the tool name) makes every enroll and start_unattended_batch call refuse with run_entry_required despite a live run entry. It fails closed, but the recovery text would mislead the user; no test pins a doubled hook run.

evidence.trigger: phaseEntryGateHookOutput invoked twice with the same tool_use_id and a live run entry, then consumePhaseAdmission for that id

findings.summary: No delivered test asserts the new hooks.json PreToolUse matcher: the Spec's agreed seam for EPE-S2-A4 (tests/claude-host-package.test.ts, control 'hooks.json matchers present') is unchanged in this revision and only checks that hooks.json exists. Fix: add a test at that seam that parses plugins/immune-brain/hooks/hooks.json and asserts a PreToolUse matcher matches 'Skill', 'mcp__plugin_immune-brain_immune-brain__enroll' and 'mcp__plugin_immune-brain_immune-brain__start_unattended_batch', with a negative control such as the status tool.

evidence.trigger: Delete or mistype the second PreToolUse entry ('Skill|mcp__.*immune-brain.*__(enroll|start_unattended_batch)') in plugins/immune-brain/hooks/hooks.json at 45bd62c4. Every test in the revision still passes: `git grep -e hooks.json -e matcher 45bd62c4 -- tests` finds only the REQUIRED existence entry at tests/claude-host-package.test.ts:30, and the three new test files call phaseEntryGateHookOutput directly with hard-coded tool names, never through the manifest. In the product the Skill gate (EPE-S2-A3) then never runs, and enroll/start_unattended_batch are refused for every user because no admission is ever written. tests/claude-host-package.test.ts is unchanged; it was read because docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md 'Verification and acceptance mapping' names it as the EPE-S2-A4 seam.

findings.summary: The 'reuseOnly continuation is not gated' bound is correct by structure but not pinned by a test: the gate test only covers child Enrollment inside one start_unattended_batch call. Consider a control at tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts that completes a batch child through advance_assurance and asserts no further admission is consumed.

evidence.trigger: Move requireRunEntry from callTool into ClaudeRuntime.startUnattendedBatch. The closeOutBatchChild continuation ({ reuseOnly: true }) would then be gated, yet tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts still passes (its only bound asserts consumed() === 1 for a single start), and the existing batch tests still pass because their withRunEntry helper runs the hook and admits on every consume call.

findings.summary: packagedPhaseSkill matches the Skill name exactly after stripping one leading '/' and one prefix, with no whitespace trimming. If the Claude Code Skill tool trims its `skill` input before resolving it (not verifiable from the revision; this is an unconfirmed assumption about the Host), a padded name would skip the gate. Consider trimming before matching and adding a denied control.

evidence.trigger: PreToolUse payload { tool_name: 'Skill', tool_input: { skill: ' imm-run' } } (or 'imm-run ') in a session with no phase entry: gatedOperation returns null, so phaseEntryGateHookOutput returns null and the call is left untouched instead of denied with phase_entry_required. Whether the Host then resolves the padded name to the packaged Skill was not confirmed.
